verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM presents itself as an AI assistant with built-in agents, which puts it in the MCP client role rather than the server role. The only MCP evidence is a page titled "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM", which describes the product consuming MCP servers. The probe labels that page an "official MCP server", but nothing explicit (such as a serve mode or a hosted MCP endpoint) shows AnythingLLM exposing itself as an MCP server, so the server axis does not apply.
